movements_usd_money_consistency.name: movements_usd_money_consistency
movements_usd_money_consistency.value:
"movements"."currency" <> 'USD'
    OR (
      "movements"."amount" > 0
      AND "movements"."amount_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "movements"."amount_usd" > 0
      AND "movements"."exchange_rate" IS NOT NULL AND "movements"."exchange_rate" > 0
      AND ABS("movements"."amount"::numeric - ROUND("movements"."amount_usd"::numeric * "movements"."exchange_rate"::numeric / 100)) <= 1000
    )

movements_source_email_identity_complete.name: movements_source_email_identity_complete
movements_source_email_identity_complete.value:
("movements"."source_email_provider" IS NULL AND "movements"."source_email_id" IS NULL)
    OR (
      "movements"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "movements"."source_email_provider" IS NOT NULL
      AND "movements"."source_email_provider" = LOWER(BTRIM("movements"."source_email_provider"))
      AND LENGTH("movements"."source_email_provider") > 0
      AND "movements"."source_email_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "movements"."source_email_id" = BTRIM("movements"."source_email_id")
      AND LENGTH("movements"."source_email_id") > 0
    )
